title: GO Battle League: Master / Mega Halloween Cup
official_leagues: Mega Halloween Cup: Great League Edition
official_rules: CP must be at or below 1,500 to enter the Mega Halloween Cup.
Only Bug-, Poison-, Ghost-, Dark-, and Fairy-type Pokémon are eligible.
official_bonus: 4x Stardust from win rewards; excludes end-of-set rewards.
